canary_security_constraints: Do not put secret plaintext in the evidence bundle
Do not put bootstrap material in the evidence bundle
Do not put KEKs, DEKs, or private keys in the evidence bundle
Do not put raw nonces or sensitive credential material in the evidence bundle
Do not put authentication credentials in the evidence bundle

canary_methodology.approach: Comprehensive plaintext search across all persistence, observability, and evidence surfaces
canary_methodology.search_term: Unique canary secret value with timestamp
canary_methodology.search_method: Byte-level string matching across all files in scope
canary_methodology.false_positive_mitigation: Canary value includes timestamp to minimize false positives
